vulg: Paulus apostolus Christi Iesu per voluntatem Dei et Timotheus frater
clem: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, et Timotheus frater:
tr: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου και τιμοθεος ο αδελφος
kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

vulg: his qui sunt Colossis sanctis et fidelibus fratribus in Christo Iesu gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre nostro
clem: eis, qui sunt Colossis, sanctis, et fidelibus fratribus in Christo Jesu.
tr: τοις εν κολασσαις  κολοσσαις   αγιοις και πιστοις αδελφοις εν χριστω χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: gratias agimus Deo et Patri Domini nostri Iesu Christi semper pro vobis orantes
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo. Gratias agimus Deo, et Patri Domini nostri Jesu Christi semper pro vobis orantes:
tr: ευχαριστουμεν τω θεω και πατρι του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου παντοτε περι υμων προσευχομενοι
kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

vulg: audientes fidem vestram in Christo Iesu et dilectionem quam habetis in sanctos omnes
clem: audientes fidem vestram in Christo Jesu, et dilectionem quam habetis in sanctos omnes
tr: ακουσαντες την πιστιν υμων εν χριστω ιησου και την αγαπην την εις παντας τους αγιους
kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

vulg: propter spem quae reposita est vobis in caelis quam audistis in verbo veritatis evangelii
clem: propter spem, qu reposita est vobis in clis: quam audistis in verbo veritatis Evangelii:
tr: δια την ελπιδα την αποκειμενην υμιν εν τοις ουρανοις ην προηκουσατε εν τω λογω της αληθειας του ευαγγελιου
kjv: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

vulg: quod pervenit ad vos sicut et in universo mundo est et fructificat et crescit sicut in vobis ex ea die qua audistis et cognovistis gratiam Dei in veritate
clem: quod pervenit ad vos, sicut et in universo mundo est, et fructificat, et crescit sicut in vobis, ex ea die, qua audistis, et cognovistis gratiam Dei in veritate,
tr: του παροντος εις υμας καθως και εν παντι τω κοσμω και εστιν καρποφορουμενον καθως και εν υμιν αφ ης ημερας ηκουσατε και επεγνωτε την χαριν του θεου εν αληθεια
kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

vulg: sicut didicistis ab Epaphra carissimo conservo nostro qui est fidelis pro vobis minister Christi Iesu
clem: sicut didicistis ab Epaphra carissimo conservo nostro, qui est fidelis pro vobis minister Christi Jesu,
tr: καθως και εμαθετε απο επαφρα του αγαπητου συνδουλου ημων ος εστιν πιστος υπερ υμων διακονος του χριστου
kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

vulg: qui etiam manifestavit nobis dilectionem vestram in Spiritu
clem: qui etiam manifestavit nobis dilectionem vestram in spiritu.
tr: ο και δηλωσας ημιν την υμων αγαπην εν πνευματι
kjv: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

vulg: ideo et nos ex qua die audivimus non cessamus pro vobis orantes et postulantes ut impleamini agnitione voluntatis eius in omni sapientia et intellectu spiritali
clem: Ideo et nos ex qua die audivimus, non cessamus pro vobis orantes, et postulantes ut impleamini agnitione voluntatis ejus, in omni sapientia et intellectu spiritali:
tr: δια τουτο και ημεις αφ ης ημερας ηκουσαμεν ου παυομεθα υπερ υμων προσευχομενοι και αιτουμενοι ινα πληρωθητε την επιγνωσιν του θεληματος αυτου εν παση σοφια και συνεσει πνευματικη
kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

vulg: ut ambuletis digne Deo per omnia placentes in omni opere bono fructificantes et crescentes in scientia Dei
clem: ut ambuletis digne Deo per omnia placentes: in omni opere bono fructificantes, et crescentes in scientia Dei:
tr: περιπατησαι υμας αξιως του κυριου εις πασαν αρεσκειαν εν παντι εργω αγαθω καρποφορουντες και αυξανομενοι εις την επιγνωσιν του θεου
kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

vulg: in omni virtute confortati secundum potentiam claritatis eius in omni patientia et longanimitate cum gaudio
clem: in omni virtute confortati secundum potentiam claritatis ejus, in omni patientia et longanimitate cum gaudio,
tr: εν παση δυναμει δυναμουμενοι κατα το κρατος της δοξης αυτου εις πασαν υπομονην και μακροθυμιαν μετα χαρας
kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

vulg: gratias agentes Patri qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctorum in lumine
clem: gratias agentes Deo Patri, qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctorum in lumine:
tr: ευχαριστουντες τω πατρι τω ικανωσαντι ημας εις την μεριδα του κληρου των αγιων εν τω φωτι
kjv: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

vulg: qui eripuit nos de potestate tenebrarum et transtulit in regnum Filii dilectionis suae
clem: qui eripuit nos de potestate tenebrarum, et transtulit in regnum filii dilectionis su,
tr: ος ερρυσατο ημας εκ της εξουσιας του σκοτους και μετεστησεν εις την βασιλειαν του υιου της αγαπης αυτου
kjv: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

vulg: in quo habemus redemptionem remissionem peccatorum
clem: in quo habemus redemptionem per sanguinem ejus, remissionem peccatorum:
tr: εν ω εχομεν την απολυτρωσιν δια του αιματος αυτου την αφεσιν των αμαρτιων
kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

vulg: qui est imago Dei invisibilis primogenitus omnis creaturae
clem: qui est imago Dei invisibilis, primogenitus omnis creatur:
tr: ος εστιν εικων του θεου του αορατου πρωτοτοκος πασης κτισεως
kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

vulg: quia in ipso condita sunt universa in caelis et in terra visibilia et invisibilia sive throni sive dominationes sive principatus sive potestates omnia per ipsum et in ipso creata sunt
clem: quoniam in ipso condita sunt universa in clis, et in terra, visibilia, et invisibilia, sive throni, sive dominationes, sive principatus, sive potestates: omnia per ipsum et in ipso creata sunt:
tr: οτι εν αυτω εκτισθη τα παντα τα εν τοις ουρανοις και τα επι της γης τα ορατα και τα αορατα ειτε θρονοι ειτε κυριοτητες ειτε αρχαι ειτε εξουσιαι τα παντα δι αυτου και εις αυτον εκτισται
kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

vulg: et ipse est ante omnes et omnia in ipso constant
clem: et ipse est ante omnes, et omnia in ipso constant.
tr: και αυτος εστιν προ παντων και τα παντα εν αυτω συνεστηκεν
kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

vulg: et ipse est caput corporis ecclesiae qui est principium primogenitus ex mortuis ut sit in omnibus ipse primatum tenens
clem: Et ipse est caput corporis Ecclesi, qui est principium, primogenitus ex mortuis: ut sit in omnibus ipse primatum tenens:
tr: και αυτος εστιν η κεφαλη του σωματος της εκκλησιας ος εστιν αρχη πρωτοτοκος εκ των νεκρων ινα γενηται εν πασιν αυτος πρωτευων
kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

vulg: quia in ipso conplacuit omnem plenitudinem habitare
clem: quia in ipso complacuit, omnem plenitudinem inhabitare:
tr: οτι εν αυτω ευδοκησεν παν το πληρωμα κατοικησαι
kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

vulg: et per eum reconciliare omnia in ipsum pacificans per sanguinem crucis eius sive quae in terris sive quae in caelis sunt
clem: et per eum reconciliare omnia in ipsum, pacificans per sanguinem crucis ejus, sive qu in terris, sive qu in clis sunt.
tr: και δι αυτου αποκαταλλαξαι τα παντα εις αυτον ειρηνοποιησας δια του αιματος του σταυρου αυτου δι αυτου ειτε τα επι της γης ειτε τα εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

vulg: et vos cum essetis aliquando alienati et inimici sensu in operibus malis
clem: Et vos cum essetis aliquando alienati, et inimici sensu in operibus malis:
tr: και υμας ποτε οντας απηλλοτριωμενους και εχθρους τη διανοια εν τοις εργοις τοις πονηροις νυνι δε αποκατηλλαξεν
kjv: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

vulg: nunc autem reconciliavit in corpore carnis eius per mortem exhibere vos sanctos et inmaculatos et inreprehensibiles coram ipso
clem: nunc autem reconciliavit in corpore carnis ejus per mortem, exhibere vos sanctos, et immaculatos, et irreprehensibiles coram ipso:
tr: εν τω σωματι της σαρκος αυτου δια του θανατου παραστησαι υμας αγιους και αμωμους και ανεγκλητους κατενωπιον αυτου
kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

vulg: si tamen permanetis in fide fundati et stabiles et inmobiles ab spe evangelii quod audistis quod praedicatum est in universa creatura quae sub caelo est cuius factus sum ego Paulus minister
clem: si tamen permanetis in fide fundati, et stabiles, et immobiles a spe Evangelii, quod audistis, quod prdicatum est in universa creatura, qu sub clo est, cujus factus sum ego Paulus minister.
tr: ειγε επιμενετε τη πιστει τεθεμελιωμενοι και εδραιοι και μη μετακινουμενοι απο της ελπιδος του ευαγγελιου ου ηκουσατε του κηρυχθεντος εν παση τη κτισει τη υπο τον ουρανον ου εγενομην εγω παυλος διακονος
kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

vulg: qui nunc gaudeo in passionibus pro vobis et adimpleo ea quae desunt passionum Christi in carne mea pro corpore eius quod est ecclesia
clem: Qui nunc gaudeo in passionibus pro vobis, et adimpleo ea qu desunt passionem Christi, in carne mea pro corpore ejus, quod est Ecclesia:
tr: ος  νυν χαιρω εν τοις παθημασιν μου υπερ υμων και ανταναπληρω τα υστερηματα των θλιψεων του χριστου εν τη σαρκι μου υπερ του σωματος αυτου ο εστιν η εκκλησια
kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

vulg: cuius factus sum ego minister secundum dispensationem Dei quae data est mihi in vos ut impleam verbum Dei
clem: cujus factus sum ego minister secundum dispensationem Dei, qu data est mihi in vos, ut impleam verbum Dei:
tr: ης εγενομην εγω διακονος κατα την οικονομιαν του θεου την δοθεισαν μοι εις υμας πληρωσαι τον λογον του θεου
kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

vulg: mysterium quod absconditum fuit a saeculis et generationibus nunc autem manifestatum est sanctis eius
clem: mysterium, quod absconditum fuit a sculis, et generationibus, nunc autem manifestatum est sanctis ejus,
tr: το μυστηριον το αποκεκρυμμενον απο των αιωνων και απο των γενεων νυνι δε εφανερωθη τοις αγιοις αυτου
kjv: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

vulg: quibus voluit Deus notas facere divitias gloriae sacramenti huius in gentibus quod est Christus in vobis spes gloriae
clem: quibus voluit Deus notas facere divitias glori sacramenti hujus in gentibus, quod est Christus, in vobis spes glori,
tr: οις ηθελησεν ο θεος γνωρισαι τις ο πλουτος της δοξης του μυστηριου τουτου εν τοις εθνεσιν ος εστιν χριστος εν υμιν η ελπις της δοξης
kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

vulg: quem nos adnuntiamus corripientes omnem hominem et docentes omnem hominem in omni sapientia ut exhibeamus omnem hominem perfectum in Christo Iesu
clem: quem nos annuntiamus, corripientes omnem hominem, et docentes omnem hominem, in omni sapientia, ut exhibeamus omnem hominem perfectum in Christo Jesu:
tr: ον ημεις καταγγελλομεν νουθετουντες παντα ανθρωπον και διδασκοντες παντα ανθρωπον εν παση σοφια ινα παραστησωμεν παντα ανθρωπον τελειον εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

vulg: in quo et laboro certando secundum operationem eius quam operatur in me in virtute
clem: in quo et laboro, certando secundum operationem ejus, quam operatur in me in virtute.
tr: εις ο και κοπιω αγωνιζομενος κατα την ενεργειαν αυτου την ενεργουμενην εν εμοι εν δυναμει
kjv: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

vulg: volo enim vos scire qualem sollicitudinem habeam pro vobis et pro his qui sunt Laodiciae et quicumque non viderunt faciem meam in carne
clem: Volo enim vos scire qualem sollicitudinem habeam pro vobis, et pro iis qui sunt Laodici, et quicumque non viderunt faciem meam in carne:
tr: θελω γαρ υμας ειδεναι ηλικον αγωνα εχω περι υμων και των εν λαοδικεια και οσοι ουχ εωρακασιν το προσωπον μου εν σαρκι
kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

vulg: ut consolentur corda ipsorum instructi in caritate et in omnes divitias plenitudinis intellectus in agnitionem mysterii Dei Patris Christi Iesu
clem: ut consolentur corda ipsorum, instructi in caritate, et in omnes divitias plenitudinis intellectus, in agnitionem mysterii Dei Patris et Christi Jesu:
tr: ινα παρακληθωσιν αι καρδιαι αυτων συμβιβασθεντων εν αγαπη και εις παντα πλουτον της πληροφοριας της συνεσεως εις επιγνωσιν του μυστηριου του θεου και πατρος και του χριστου
kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

vulg: in quo sunt omnes thesauri sapientiae et scientiae absconditi
clem: in quo sunt omnes thesauri sapienti et scienti absconditi.
tr: εν ω εισιν παντες οι θησαυροι της σοφιας και της γνωσεως αποκρυφοι
kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

vulg: hoc autem dico ut nemo vos decipiat in subtilitate sermonum
clem: Hoc autem dico, ut nemo vos decipiat in sublimitate sermonum.
tr: τουτο δε λεγω ινα μη τις υμας παραλογιζηται εν πιθανολογια
kjv: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

vulg: nam et si corpore absens sum sed spiritu vobiscum sum gaudens et videns ordinem vestrum et firmamentum eius quae in Christo est fidei vestrae
clem: Nam etsi corpore absens sum, sed spiritu vobiscum sum: gaudens, et videns ordinem vestrum, et firmamentum ejus, qu in Christo est, fidei vestr.
tr: ει γαρ και τη σαρκι απειμι αλλα τω πνευματι συν υμιν ειμι χαιρων και βλεπων υμων την ταξιν και το στερεωμα της εις χριστον πιστεως υμων
kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

vulg: sicut ergo accepistis Christum Iesum Dominum in ipso ambulate
clem: Sicut ergo accepistis Jesum Christum Dominum, in ipso ambulate,
tr: ως ουν παρελαβετε τον χριστον ιησουν τον κυριον εν αυτω περιπατειτε
kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

vulg: radicati et superaedificati in ipso et confirmati fide sicut et didicistis abundantes in gratiarum actione
clem: radicati, et superdificati in ipso, et confirmati fide, sicut et didicistis, abundantes in illo in gratiarum actione.
tr: ερριζωμενοι και εποικοδομουμενοι εν αυτω και βεβαιουμενοι εν τη πιστει καθως εδιδαχθητε περισσευοντες εν αυτη εν ευχαριστια
kjv: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

vulg: videte ne quis vos decipiat per philosophiam et inanem fallaciam secundum traditionem hominum secundum elementa mundi et non secundum Christum
clem: Videte ne quis vos decipiat per philosophiam, et inanem fallaciam secundum traditionem hominum, secundum elementa mundi, et non secundum Christum:
tr: βλεπετε μη τις υμας εσται ο συλαγωγων δια της φιλοσοφιας και κενης απατης κατα την παραδοσιν των ανθρωπων κατα τα στοιχεια του κοσμου και ου κατα χριστον
kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

vulg: quia in ipso inhabitat omnis plenitudo divinitatis corporaliter
clem: quia in ipso inhabitat omnis plenitudo divinitatis corporaliter:
tr: οτι εν αυτω κατοικει παν το πληρωμα της θεοτητος σωματικως
kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

vulg: et estis in illo repleti qui est caput omnis principatus et potestatis
clem: et estis in illo repleti, qui est caput omnis principatus et potestatis:
tr: και εστε εν αυτω πεπληρωμενοι ος εστιν η κεφαλη πασης αρχης και εξουσιας
kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

vulg: in quo et circumcisi estis circumcisione non manufacta in expoliatione corporis carnis in circumcisione Christi
clem: in quo et circumcisi estis circumcisione non manu facta in expoliatione corporis carnis, sed in circumcisione Christi:
tr: εν ω και περιετμηθητε περιτομη αχειροποιητω εν τη απεκδυσει του σωματος των αμαρτιων της σαρκος εν τη περιτομη του χριστου
kjv: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

vulg: consepulti ei in baptismo in quo et resurrexistis per fidem operationis Dei qui suscitavit illum a mortuis
clem: consepulti ei in baptismo, in quo et resurrexistis per fidem operationis Dei, qui suscitavit illum a mortuis.
tr: συνταφεντες αυτω εν τω βαπτισματι εν ω και συνηγερθητε δια της πιστεως της ενεργειας του θεου του εγειραντος αυτον εκ των νεκρων
kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

vulg: et vos cum mortui essetis in delictis et praeputio carnis vestrae convivificavit cum illo donans vobis omnia delicta
clem: Et vos cum mortui essetis in delictis, et prputio carnis vestr, convivificavit cum illo, donans vobis omnia delicta:
tr: και υμας νεκρους οντας εν τοις παραπτωμασιν και τη ακροβυστια της σαρκος υμων συνεζωποιησεν  συνεζωοποιησεν  συν αυτω χαρισαμενος ημιν  υμιν  παντα τα παραπτωματα
kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

vulg: delens quod adversum nos erat chirografum decretis quod erat contrarium nobis et ipsum tulit de medio adfigens illud cruci
clem: delens quod adversus nos erat chirographum decreti, quod erat contrarium nobis, et ipsum tulit de medio, affigens illud cruci:
tr: εξαλειψας το καθ ημων χειρογραφον τοις δογμασιν ο ην υπεναντιον ημιν και αυτο ηρκεν εκ του μεσου προσηλωσας αυτο τω σταυρω
kjv: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

vulg: expolians principatus et potestates traduxit palam triumphans illos in semet ipso
clem: et expolians principatus, et potestates traduxit confidenter, palam triumphans illos in semetipso.
tr: απεκδυσαμενος τας αρχας και τας εξουσιας εδειγματισεν εν παρρησια θριαμβευσας αυτους εν αυτω
kjv: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

vulg: nemo ergo vos iudicet in cibo aut in potu aut in parte diei festi aut neomeniae aut sabbatorum
clem: Nemo ergo vos judicet in cibo, aut in potu, aut in parte diei festi, aut neomeni, aut sabbatorum:
tr: μη ουν τις υμας κρινετω εν βρωσει η εν ποσει η εν μερει εορτης η νουμηνιας η σαββατων
kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

vulg: quae sunt umbra futurorum corpus autem Christi
clem: qu sunt umbra futurorum: corpus autem Christi.
tr: α εστιν σκια των μελλοντων το δε σωμα του χριστου
kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

vulg: nemo vos seducat volens in humilitate et religione angelorum quae non vidit ambulans frustra inflatus sensu carnis suae
clem: Nemo vos seducat, volens in humilitate, et religione angelorum, qu non vidit ambulans, frustra inflatus sensu carnis su,
tr: μηδεις υμας καταβραβευετω θελων εν ταπεινοφροσυνη και θρησκεια των αγγελων α μη εωρακεν εμβατευων εικη φυσιουμενος υπο του νοος της σαρκος αυτου
kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

vulg: et non tenens caput ex quo totum corpus per nexus et coniunctiones subministratum et constructum crescit in augmentum Dei
clem: et non tenens caput, ex quo totum corpus per nexus, et conjunctiones subministratum, et constructum crescit in augmentum Dei.
tr: και ου κρατων την κεφαλην εξ ου παν το σωμα δια των αφων και συνδεσμων επιχορηγουμενον και συμβιβαζομενον αυξει την αυξησιν του θεου
kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

vulg: si mortui estis cum Christo ab elementis mundi quid adhuc tamquam viventes in mundo decernitis
clem: Si ergo mortui estis cum Christo ab elementis hujus mundi: quid adhuc tamquam viventes in mundo decernitis?
tr: ει ουν απεθανετε συν τω χριστω απο των στοιχειων του κοσμου τι ως ζωντες εν κοσμω δογματιζεσθε
kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

vulg: ne tetigeris neque gustaveris neque contrectaveris
clem: Ne tetigeritis, neque gustaveritis, neque contrectaveritis:
tr: μη αψη μηδε γευση μηδε θιγης
kjv: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

vulg: quae sunt omnia in interitu ipso usu secundum praecepta et doctrinas hominum
clem: qu sunt omnia in interitum ipso usu, secundum prcepta et doctrinas hominum:
tr: α εστιν παντα εις φθοραν τη αποχρησει κατα τα ενταλματα και διδασκαλιας των ανθρωπων
kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

vulg: quae sunt rationem quidem habentia sapientiae in superstitione et humilitate et ad non parcendum corpori non in honore aliquo ad saturitatem carnis
clem: qu sunt rationem quidem habentia sapienti in superstitione, et humilitate, et non ad parcendum corpori, non in honore aliquo ad saturitatem carnis.
tr: ατινα εστιν λογον μεν εχοντα σοφιας εν εθελοθρησκεια και ταπεινοφροσυνη και αφειδια σωματος ουκ εν τιμη τινι προς πλησμονην της σαρκος
kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

vulg: igitur si conresurrexistis Christo quae sursum sunt quaerite ubi Christus est in dextera Dei sedens
clem: Igitur, si consurrexistis cum Christo: qu sursum sunt qurite, ubi Christus est in dextera Dei sedens:
tr: ει ουν συνηγερθητε τω χριστω τα ανω ζητειτε ου ο χριστος εστιν εν δεξια του θεου καθημενος
kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

vulg: quae sursum sunt sapite non quae supra terram
clem: qu sursum sunt sapite, non qu super terram.
tr: τα ανω φρονειτε μη τα επι της γης
kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

vulg: mortui enim estis et vita vestra abscondita est cum Christo in Deo
clem: Mortui enim estis, et vita vestra est abscondita cum Christo in Deo.
tr: απεθανετε γαρ και η ζωη υμων κεκρυπται συν τω χριστω εν τω θεω
kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

vulg: cum Christus apparuerit vita vestra tunc et vos apparebitis cum ipso in gloria
clem: Cum Christus apparuerit, vita vestra: tunc et vos apparebitis cum ipso in gloria.
tr: οταν ο χριστος φανερωθη η ζωη ημων τοτε και υμεις συν αυτω φανερωθησεσθε εν δοξη
kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

vulg: mortificate ergo membra vestra quae sunt super terram fornicationem inmunditiam libidinem concupiscentiam malam et avaritiam quae est simulacrorum servitus
clem: Mortificate ergo membra vestra, qu sunt super terram: fornicationem, immunditiam, libidinem, concupiscentiam malam, et avaritiam, qu est simulacrorum servitus:
tr: νεκρωσατε ουν τα μελη υμων τα επι της γης πορνειαν ακαθαρσιαν παθος επιθυμιαν κακην και την πλεονεξιαν ητις εστιν ειδωλολατρεια
kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

vulg: propter quae venit ira Dei super filios incredulitatis
clem: propter qu venit ira Dei super filios incredulitatis:
tr: δι α ερχεται η οργη του θεου επι τους υιους της απειθειας
kjv: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

vulg: in quibus et vos ambulastis aliquando cum viveretis in illis
clem: in quibus et vos ambulastis aliquando, cum viveritis in illis.
tr: εν οις και υμεις περιεπατησατε ποτε οτε εζητε εν αυτοις
kjv: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

vulg: nunc autem deponite et vos omnia iram indignationem malitiam blasphemiam turpem sermonem de ore vestro
clem: Nunc autem deponite et vos omnia: iram, indignationem, malitiam, blasphemiam, turpem sermonem de ore vestro.
tr: νυνι δε αποθεσθε και υμεις τα παντα οργην θυμον κακιαν βλασφημιαν αισχρολογιαν εκ του στοματος υμων
kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

vulg: nolite mentiri invicem expoliantes vos veterem hominem cum actibus eius
clem: Nolite mentiri invicem, expoliantes vos veterem hominem cum actibus suis,
tr: μη ψευδεσθε εις αλληλους απεκδυσαμενοι τον παλαιον ανθρωπον συν ταις πραξεσιν αυτου
kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

vulg: et induentes novum eum qui renovatur in agnitionem secundum imaginem eius qui creavit eum
clem: et induentes novum eum, qui renovatur in agnitionem secundum imaginem ejus qui creavit illum:
tr: και ενδυσαμενοι τον νεον τον ανακαινουμενον εις επιγνωσιν κατ εικονα του κτισαντος αυτον
kjv: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

vulg: ubi non est gentilis et Iudaeus circumcisio et praeputium barbarus et Scytha servus et liber sed omnia et in omnibus Christus
clem: ubi non est gentilis et Judus, circumcisio et prputium, Barbarus et Scytha, servus et liber: sed omnia, et in omnibus Christus.
tr: οπου ουκ ενι ελλην και ιουδαιος περιτομη και ακροβυστια βαρβαρος σκυθης δουλος ελευθερος αλλα τα παντα και εν πασιν χριστος
kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

vulg: induite vos ergo sicut electi Dei sancti et dilecti viscera misericordiae benignitatem humilitatem modestiam patientiam
clem: Induite vos ergo, sicut electi Dei, sancti, et dilecti, viscera misericordi, benignitatem, humilitatem, modestiam, patientiam:
tr: ενδυσασθε ουν ως εκλεκτοι του θεου αγιοι και ηγαπημενοι σπλαγχνα οικτιρμων χρηστοτητα ταπεινοφροσυνην πραοτητα μακροθυμιαν
kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

vulg: subportantes invicem et donantes vobis ipsis si quis adversus aliquem habet querellam sicut et Dominus donavit vobis ita et vos
clem: supportantes invicem, et donantes vobismetipsis si quis adversus aliquem habet querelam: sicut et Dominus donavit vobis, ita et vos.
tr: ανεχομενοι αλληλων και χαριζομενοι εαυτοις εαν τις προς τινα εχη μομφην καθως και ο χριστος εχαρισατο υμιν ουτως και υμεις
kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

vulg: super omnia autem haec caritatem quod est vinculum perfectionis
clem: Super omnia autem hc, caritatem habete, quod est vinculum perfectionis:
tr: επι πασιν δε τουτοις την αγαπην ητις εστιν συνδεσμος της τελειοτητος
kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

vulg: et pax Christi exultet in cordibus vestris in qua et vocati estis in uno corpore et grati estote
clem: et pax Christi exsultet in cordibus vestris, in qua et vocati estis in uno corpore: et grati estote.
tr: και η ειρηνη του θεου βραβευετω εν ταις καρδιαις υμων εις ην και εκληθητε εν ενι σωματι και ευχαριστοι γινεσθε
kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

vulg: verbum Christi habitet in vobis abundanter in omni sapientia docentes et commonentes vosmet ipsos psalmis hymnis canticis spiritalibus in gratia cantantes in cordibus vestris Deo
clem: Verbum Christi habitet in vobis abundanter, in omni sapientia, docentes, et commonentes vosmetipsos, psalmis, hymnis, et canticis spiritualibus, in gratia cantantes in cordibus vestris Deo.
tr: ο λογος του χριστου ενοικειτω εν υμιν πλουσιως εν παση σοφια διδασκοντες και νουθετουντες εαυτους ψαλμοις και υμνοις και ωδαις πνευματικαις εν χαριτι αδοντες εν τη καρδια υμων τω κυριω
kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

vulg: omne quodcumque facitis in verbo aut in opere omnia in nomine Domini Iesu gratias agentes Deo et Patri per ipsum
clem: Omne, quodcumque facitis in verbo aut in opere, omnia in nomine Domini Jesu Christi, gratias agentes Deo et Patri per ipsum.
tr: και παν ο τι αν ποιητε εν λογω η εν εργω παντα εν ονοματι κυριου ιησου ευχαριστουντες τω θεω και πατρι δι αυτου
kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

vulg: mulieres subditae estote viris sicut oportet in Domino
clem: Mulieres, subdit estote viris, sicut oportet, in Domino.
tr: αι γυναικες υποτασσεσθε τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν ως ανηκεν εν κυριω
kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

vulg: viri diligite uxores et nolite amari esse ad illas
clem: Viri, diligite uxores vestras, et nolite amari esse ad illas.
tr: οι ανδρες αγαπατε τας γυναικας και μη πικραινεσθε προς αυτας
kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

vulg: filii oboedite parentibus per omnia hoc enim placitum est in Domino
clem: Filii, obedite parentibus per omnia: hoc enim placitum est in Domino.
tr: τα τεκνα υπακουετε τοις γονευσιν κατα παντα τουτο γαρ εστιν ευαρεστον τω κυριω
kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

vulg: patres nolite ad indignationem provocare filios vestros ut non pusillo animo fiant
clem: Patres, nolite ad indignationem provocare filios vestros, ut non pusillo animo fiant.
tr: οι πατερες μη ερεθιζετε τα τεκνα υμων ινα μη αθυμωσιν
kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

vulg: servi oboedite per omnia dominis carnalibus non ad oculum servientes quasi hominibus placentes sed in simplicitate cordis timentes Dominum
clem: Servi, obedite per omnia dominis carnalibus, non ad oculum servientes, quasi hominibus placentes, sed in simplicitate cordis, timentes Deum.
tr: οι δουλοι υπακουετε κατα παντα τοις κατα σαρκα κυριοις μη εν οφθαλμοδουλειαις ως ανθρωπαρεσκοι αλλ εν απλοτητι καρδιας φοβουμενοι τον θεον
kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;

vulg: quodcumque facitis ex animo operamini sicut Domino et non hominibus
clem: Quodcumque facitis, ex animo operamini sicut Domino, et non hominibus:
tr: και παν ο τι εαν ποιητε εκ ψυχης εργαζεσθε ως τω κυριω και ουκ ανθρωποις
kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

vulg: scientes quod a Domino accipietis retributionem hereditatis Domino Christo servite
clem: scientes quod a Domino accipietis retributionem hreditatis. Domino Christo servite.
tr: ειδοτες οτι απο κυριου αποληψεσθε την ανταποδοσιν της κληρονομιας τω γαρ κυριω χριστω δουλευετε
kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

vulg: qui enim iniuriam facit recipiet id quod inique gessit et non est personarum acceptio
clem: Qui enim injuriam facit, recipiet id quod inique gessit: et non est personarum acceptio apud Deum.
tr: ο δε αδικων κομιειται ο ηδικησεν και ουκ εστιν προσωποληψια
kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

vulg: domini quod iustum est et aequum servis praestate scientes quoniam et vos Dominum habetis in caelo
clem: Domini, quod justum est et quum, servis prstate: scientes quod et vos Dominum habetis in clo.
tr: οι κυριοι το δικαιον και την ισοτητα τοις δουλοις παρεχεσθε ειδοτες οτι και υμεις εχετε κυριον εν ουρανοις
kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

vulg: orationi instate vigilantes in ea in gratiarum actione
clem: Orationi instate, vigilantes in ea in gratiarum actione:
tr: τη προσευχη προσκαρτερειτε γρηγορουντες εν αυτη εν ευχαριστια
kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

vulg: orantes simul et pro nobis ut Deus aperiat nobis ostium sermonis ad loquendum mysterium Christi propter quod etiam vinctus sum
clem: orantes simul et pro nobis, ut Deus aperiat nobis ostium sermonis ad loquendum mysterium Christi (propter quod etiam vinctus sum),
tr: προσευχομενοι αμα και περι ημων ινα ο θεος ανοιξη ημιν θυραν του λογου λαλησαι το μυστηριον του χριστου δι ο και δεδεμαι
kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

vulg: ut manifestem illud ita ut oportet me loqui
clem: ut manifestem illud ita ut oportet me loqui.
tr: ινα φανερωσω αυτο ως δει με λαλησαι
kjv: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

vulg: in sapientia ambulate ad eos qui foris sunt tempus redimentes
clem: In sapientia ambulate ad eos, qui foris sunt: tempus redimentes.
tr: εν σοφια περιπατειτε προς τους εξω τον καιρον εξαγοραζομενοι
kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

vulg: sermo vester semper in gratia sale sit conditus ut sciatis quomodo oporteat vos unicuique respondere
clem: Sermo vester semper in gratia sale sit conditus, ut sciatis quomodo oporteat vos unicuique respondere.
tr: ο λογος υμων παντοτε εν χαριτι αλατι ηρτυμενος ειδεναι πως δει υμας ενι εκαστω αποκρινεσθαι
kjv: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

vulg: quae circa me sunt omnia vobis nota faciet Tychicus carissimus frater et fidelis minister et conservus in Domino
clem: Qu circa me sunt, omnia vobis nota faciet Tychicus, carissimus frater, et fidelis minister, et conservus in Domino:
tr: τα κατ εμε παντα γνωρισει υμιν τυχικος ο αγαπητος αδελφος και πιστος διακονος και συνδουλος εν κυριω
kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

vulg: quem misi ad vos ad hoc ipsum ut cognoscat quae circa vos sunt et consoletur corda vestra
clem: quem misi ad vos ad hoc ipsum, ut cognoscat qu circa vos sunt, et consoletur corda vestra,
tr: ον επεμψα προς υμας εις αυτο τουτο ινα γνω τα περι υμων και παρακαλεση τας καρδιας υμων
kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

vulg: cum Onesimo carissimo et fideli fratre qui est ex vobis omnia quae hic aguntur nota facient vobis
clem: cum Onesimo carissimo, et fideli fratre, qui ex vobis est. Omnia, qu hic aguntur, nota facient vobis.
tr: συν ονησιμω τω πιστω και αγαπητω αδελφω ος εστιν εξ υμων παντα υμιν γνωριουσιν τα ωδε
kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

vulg: salutat vos Aristarchus concaptivus meus et Marcus consobrinus Barnabae de quo accepistis mandata si venerit ad vos excipite illum
clem: Salutat vos Aristarchus concaptivus meus, et Marcus consobrinus Barnab, de quo accepistis mandata: si venerit ad vos, excipite illum:
tr: ασπαζεται υμας αρισταρχος ο συναιχμαλωτος μου και μαρκος ο ανεψιος βαρναβα 921 {N-GSM}  {N-DSM}  περι ου ελαβετε εντολας εαν ελθη προς υμας δεξασθε αυτον
kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

vulg: et Iesus qui dicitur Iustus qui sunt ex circumcisione hii soli sunt adiutores in regno Dei qui mihi fuerunt solacio
clem: et Jesus, qui dicitur Justus: qui sunt ex circumcisione: hi soli sunt adjutores mei in regno Dei, qui mihi fuerunt solatio.
tr: και ιησους ο λεγομενος ιουστος οι οντες εκ περιτομης ουτοι μονοι συνεργοι εις την βασιλειαν του θεου οιτινες εγενηθησαν μοι παρηγορια
kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

vulg: salutat vos Epaphras qui ex vobis est servus Christi Iesu semper sollicitus pro vobis in orationibus ut stetis perfecti et pleni in omni voluntate Dei
clem: Salutat vos Epaphras, qui ex vobis est, servus Christi Jesu, semper sollicitus pro vobis in orationibus, ut stetis perfecti, et pleni in omni voluntate Dei.
tr: ασπαζεται υμας επαφρας ο εξ υμων δουλος χριστου παντοτε αγωνιζομενος υπερ υμων εν ταις προσευχαις ινα στητε τελειοι και πεπληρωμενοι εν παντι θεληματι του θεου
kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

vulg: testimonium enim illi perhibeo quod habet multum laborem pro vobis et pro his qui sunt Laodiciae et qui Hierapoli
clem: Testimonium enim illi perhibeo quod habet multum laborem pro vobis, et pro iis qui sunt Laodici, et qui Hierapoli.
tr: μαρτυρω γαρ αυτω οτι εχει ζηλον πολυν υπερ υμων και των εν λαοδικεια και των εν ιεραπολει
kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

vulg: salutat vos Lucas medicus carissimus et Demas
clem: Salutat vos Lucas, medicus carissimus, et Demas.
tr: ασπαζεται υμας λουκας ο ιατρος ο αγαπητος και δημας
kjv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

vulg: salutate fratres qui sunt Laodiciae et Nympham et quae in domo eius est ecclesiam
clem: Salutate fratres, qui sunt Laodici, et Nympham, et qu in domo ejus est, ecclesiam.
tr: ασπασασθε τους εν λαοδικεια αδελφους και νυμφαν και την κατ οικον αυτου εκκλησιαν
kjv: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

vulg: et cum lecta fuerit apud vos epistula facite ut et in Laodicensium ecclesia legatur et eam quae Laodicensium est vos legatis
clem: Et cum lecta fuerit apud vos epistola hc, facite ut et in Laodicensium ecclesia legatur: et eam, qu Laodicensium est, vos legatis.
tr: και οταν αναγνωσθη παρ υμιν η επιστολη ποιησατε ινα και εν τη λαοδικεων εκκλησια αναγνωσθη και την εκ λαοδικειας ινα και υμεις αναγνωτε
kjv: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

vulg: et dicite Archippo vide ministerium quod accepisti in Domino ut illud impleas
clem: Et dicite Archippo: Vide ministerium, quod accepisti in Domino, ut illud impleas.
tr: και ειπατε αρχιππω βλεπε την διακονιαν ην παρελαβες εν κυριω ινα αυτην πληροις
kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

vulg: salutatio mea manu Pauli memores estote vinculorum meorum gratia vobiscum amen
clem: Salutatio, mea manu Pauli. Memores estote vinculorum meorum. Gratia vobiscum. Amen.
tr: ο ασπασμος τη εμη χειρι παυλου μνημονευετε μου των δεσμων η χαρις μεθ υμων αμην [ προς κολασσαεις εγραφη απο ρωμης δια τυχικου και ονησιμου]
kjv: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
